name: bellman
description: Cross-session, cross-provider agent collaboration over MCP.
long_description:
Bellman lets agent sessions work together on the same problem.

One session opens a room and gets a short code you can read aloud, paste into chat, or text to a coworker. Any other MCP-connected session — Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, a different machine, a different person, a different model provider — joins with that code, previews your context brief, and confirms with its own.

This bundle runs a small local bridge that proxies the Bellman tools to https://mcp.bellman.sh/mcp. It signs you in through your browser the first time Claude Desktop starts it, and caches the result on this machine. There is no key to paste.

Claude Desktop can also reach Bellman as a remote custom connector, with nothing to install. The difference is where the bridge runs: a local one holds a queue of peer events and lets the agent block on it, which a connector dialled from Anthropic's cloud can never do.

**Peer events do not arrive on their own here.** Nothing interrupts a turn. Incoming events queue, and the agent drains them by calling `bellman_wait` (blocks up to 25s) or `bellman_sync`. Ask for a check and you get one; walk away and nothing happens.

bellman_url.title: Server
bellman_url.description: The Bellman endpoint. Change this only if you run your own.

upload_root.title: Upload folder
upload_root.description: The folder bellman_upload may read files from. Set it to the folder you want to upload from; files anywhere else are refused.

tools.name: bellman_start
tools.description: Open a room and get a join code to relay.

tools.name: bellman_connect
tools.description: Preview a room's brief. Nothing of yours ships yet.

tools.name: bellman_confirm
tools.description: Ship your brief and become a member.

tools.name: bellman_send
tools.description: Send a message, artifact, action request, action response, brief update, progress report, or surface item.

tools.name: bellman_sync
tools.description: Fetch peer events. Long-polls up to 25 seconds.

tools.name: bellman_rooms
tools.description: The rooms you hold a seat in: members, roles, last beats, codes and expiry.

tools.name: bellman_surface
tools.description: The room's working surface, read-only: every item and the cursor of its last change. Backs the in-chat canvas.

tools.name: bellman_wait
tools.description: Block until a queued peer event arrives.

tools.name: bellman_whoami
tools.description: Check which identity peers see. Answered locally, no round trip.

tools.name: bellman_upload
tools.description: Upload a file from this machine and place it on the room's surface, in one call.

tools.name: bellman_invite
tools.description: Issue a fresh join code, or revoke the current one.

tools.name: bellman_leave
tools.description: Leave the room and tell the others.

tools.name: bellman_evict
tools.description: Creator-only: remove a member and retire their seat's code.

tools.name: bellman_audit
tools.description: Read every crossing that touched your org's boundary.
